@@ -118,6 +118,9 @@ ambiguous wording, reword the user-facing text instead of flipping the logic.
 - N2 nearly exhausted entry headroom while byte budgets still passed. Count directories/skipped ZIP entries and coordinate the content
   publishing guard with `SafeZip` (see `docs/DESIGN.md`); more entry capacity does not relax byte limits or upgrade installed APKs.
   Complete-archive integration fixtures must honor Git `export-ignore` too, rather than zip contributor evidence that never ships.
+- Real-corpus fixtures share `PublishableContentFixture`: use NUL-delimited Git publication selection and reject excluded manifest
+  dependencies before loading the corpus. Walking all non-`.git` files retained 1.56 GiB of contributor evidence and exhausted a
+  2 GiB test heap (#130); preserve that evidence in Git rather than deleting it or raising heap limits as documentation grows.
 - Sync diagnostics are not rejected-card counts: optional metadata warnings keep their owning cards.
   Report distinct rejected files with explicit units, and count retained Listening catalogs from the accepted cache, excluding unsupported placeholders.
 - Counter reading metadata belongs to the displayed canonical phrase, not every counter in legacy `kana`.

+package io.github.stopcran.kanji.core
+
+import java.io.File
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
+import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Rule
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
+
+class PublishableContentFixtureTest {
+    @get:Rule
+    val temporary = TemporaryFolder()
+
+    @Test
+    fun keepsTrackedAndUntrackedPublicationFilesWithoutReadingContributorEvidence() {
+        val root = repository()
+        write(root, "manifest.json", """{"files":{"kanji/\u65e5.md":"hash"}}""")
+        val kanji = "kanji/\u65e5.md"
+        write(root, kanji, "tracked kanji")
+        git(root, "add", "--", "manifest.json", kanji, ".gitattributes")
+        write(root, "words/extra word.md", "unmanifested local addition")
+        write(root, ".gitignore", "ignored/\n")
+        write(root, "ignored/local.bin", "ignored local data")
+        write(root, "docs/reviews/nested/evidence.txt", "preserved evidence")
+        write(root, "tools/local.py", "contributor tool")
+        write(root, ".github/workflows/test.yml", "contributor workflow")
+        git(root, "add", "--", "docs", "tools", ".github")
+
+        val files = PublishableContentFixture.load(root)
+
+        assertEquals(setOf("manifest.json", kanji, "words/extra word.md", ".gitattributes", ".gitignore"), files.keys)
+        assertArrayEquals("tracked kanji".toByteArray(), files.getValue(kanji))
+        assertArrayEquals("unmanifested local addition".toByteArray(), files.getValue("words/extra word.md"))
+        assertEquals("preserved evidence", File(root, "docs/reviews/nested/evidence.txt").readText())
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun rejectsExportIgnoredDependenciesInEveryManifestMap() {
+        val root = repository()
+        val path = "docs/required.json"
+        write(root, path, "{}")
+        for (section in listOf("files", "images", "scenes", "listening", "audio", "curriculum",
+            "listeningTasks", "listeningTaskAudio", "listeningTaskImages")) {
+            write(root, "manifest.json", JsonObject(mapOf(
+                section to JsonObject(mapOf(path to JsonPrimitive("hash"))),
+            )).toString())
+            val error = assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
+                PublishableContentFixture.load(root)
+            }
+            assertTrue(section, error.message.orEmpty().contains(path))
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun rejectsExportIgnoredManifest() {
+        val root = repository()
+        write(root, "manifest.json", """{"files":{}}""")
+        File(root, ".gitattributes").appendText("/manifest.json export-ignore\n")
+        val error = assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
+            PublishableContentFixture.load(root)
+        }
+        assertTrue(error.message.orEmpty().contains("excludes manifest.json"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun failsWhenGitCannotListTheRepository() {
+        val root = temporary.newFolder()
+        write(root, "manifest.json", """{"files":{}}""")
+        val error = assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
+            PublishableContentFixture.load(root)
+        }
+        assertTrue(error.message.orEmpty().contains("git ls-files failed"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun preservesUnicodeSpacesAndEmbeddedLineBreaksInNulDelimitedPaths() {
+        val paths = listOf("kanji/\u65e5.md", "words/with space.md", "articles/line\nbreak\tname.md")
+        val output = (paths.joinToString("\^@") + "\^@").toByteArray()
+        assertEquals(paths, PublishableContentFixture.decodePaths(output))
+    }
+
+    private fun repository(): File = temporary.newFolder().also { root ->
+        git(root, "init", "--quiet")
+        write(root, ".gitattributes", """
+            /docs export-ignore
+            /docs/** export-ignore
+            /tools export-ignore
+            /tools/** export-ignore
+            /.github export-ignore
+            /.github/** export-ignore
+        """.trimIndent() + "\n")
+    }
+
+    private fun write(root: File, path: String, text: String) {
+        File(root, path).also {
+            it.parentFile.mkdirs()
+            it.writeText(text)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun git(root: File, vararg arguments: String) {
+        val command = ProcessBuilder(listOf("git", "-C", root.absolutePath) + arguments)
+            .redirectErrorStream(true).start()
+        val output = command.inputStream.use { it.readBytes().decodeToString() }
+        assertEquals(output, 0, command.waitFor())
+    }
+}

@@ -823,6 +823,11 @@ Testing seams: network goes through `ContentHttp` (tests use a fake), feature st
 UI tests (`ComposeUiTest`) run on Robolectric for the stateless pieces (answer feedback, article toggle, page chrome). Static analysis is Detekt
 with a baseline (`config/detekt`); new code must add no findings, and the baseline should only shrink.
 
+Real-corpus JVM fixtures load the complete publishable working tree through Git's `export-ignore` selection, including non-ignored
+local additions, rather than eagerly retaining contributor documentation. Both direct parsing and mixed-archive compatibility use
+the same test-only loader; it fails on Git errors or excluded manifest dependencies before reading the corpus. Every existing parser
+assertion and archive budget remains in force. Contributor source/review evidence stays in Git and local checkouts (#130).
+
